newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-INDIA DROP AZHARUDDIN, RECALL KAMBLI.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA DROP AZHARUDDIN, RECALL KAMBLI.

text.p: Indian cricket selectors on Tuesday dropped former captain Mohammed Azharuddin and recalled left-handed batsman Vinod Kambli to their squad for the four-nation Independence Cup one-day tournament this month.

The selectors also introduced 22-year-old opening batsman Gagan Khoda to the 14-man squad in place of injured opener Navjot Sidhu, who declared himself unavailable because of a torn muscle and a hamstring injury.
They also omitted wicket-keeper batsman Saba Karim and batsman Vangipurappu Laxman from the 16-member team that toured West Indies this year.
Paceman Javagal Srinath, who pulled out because of injury before the twin tour of South Africa and West Indies, is still not fit to play.

Jagmohan Dalmiya, secretary of the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI), told reporters after a meeting of the selection committee that the team announced on Tuesday would be for the three preliminary matches of the Independence Cup.

Kambli, a school-mate of skipper Sachin Tendulkar, is staging a comeback after a fruitful domestic season, while opener Khoda, who plays for Rajasthan in domestic cricket, is rated a promising prospect.
India, New Zealand, Pakistan and world champions Sri Lanka are scheduled to play each other in the single-leg round-robin league of the Independence Cup between May 9 and 21.
The two teams topping the standings are scheduled to play two final matches on May 24 and 27.
A decisive third final, if necessary, would be played on May 28.

Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Saurav Ganguly, Gagan Khoda, Rahul Dravid, Vinod Kambli, Ajay Jadeja, Robin Singh, Nayan Mongia, Anil Kumble, Noel David, Sunil Joshi, Venkatesh Prasad, Abey Kuruvilla, Dodda Ganesh.
